import sys

MAX_SIZE = 250010
fact = [1] * MAX_SIZE
invFact = [1] * MAX_SIZE
dpStates = [[0] * MAX_SIZE for _ in range(30)]
bitsCount = [0] * MAX_SIZE

def choose(n, r, modVal):
    return fact[n] * invFact[n - r] % modVal * invFact[r] % modVal

def add_value(x, y, modVal):
    x[0] += y
    if x[0] >= modVal:
        x[0] -= modVal

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    totalCount = int(input_data[0])
    maxLimit = int(input_data[1])
    modVal = int(input_data[2])

    fact[0] = invFact[0] = 1
    fact[1] = invFact[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, totalCount + 1):
        q = modVal // i
        r = modVal - i * q
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % modVal
        invFact[i] = modVal - (q * invFact[r] % modVal)
    for i in range(2, totalCount + 1):
        invFact[i] = invFact[i - 1] * invFact[i] % modVal

    result = 1
    for i in range(1, totalCount + 1):
        result = result * maxLimit % modVal

    for i in range(1, totalCount + 1):
        bitsCount[i] = bitsCount[i >> 1] + (i & 1)

    if totalCount & 1:
        print(result)
        return

    dpStates[0][0] = 1
    maxBits = min(bitsCount[totalCount], maxLimit)
    for i in range(maxBits):
        for j in range(totalCount):
            if dpStates[i][j] == 0:
                continue
            mask = totalCount ^ j
            k = mask
            while k > j:
                r = k | j
                add_value([dpStates[i + 1][r]], (dpStates[i][j] * invFact[k]) % modVal, modVal)
                k = (k - 1) & mask

    for i in range(1, maxLimit + 1):
        temp = (dpStates[i][totalCount] * fact[maxLimit]) % modVal
        temp = (temp * invFact[maxLimit - i]) % modVal
        temp = (temp * fact[totalCount]) % modVal
        result -= temp

    result = (modVal + result % modVal) % modVal
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
